text:
Maya: quick heads-up — PR #4893 updates the runtime-config page and replaces a bunch of SDK snippets. Need a fast voice/terminology pass before we merge. :memo:
Sam: passing the link — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4893 :eyes:
Liam: skimmed the diff. two things: 1) we changed 'Dedicated' -> 'dedicated instance' in a few spots, 2) examples use both 'model' and 'model_name' which is confusing for SDK users
Noelle: thanks. can we standardize on 'model' (param) and in prose use 'model version' when referring to the pinned artifact?
Ryan: agreed on param naming. SDKs expose `model` across languages. we should add a tiny migration note in the SDK snippets section.
Maya: ok — plan: Noelle owns the prose rename, Ryan adds migration snippet + callout, Liam does a glossary entry for 'model vs model version' and I will do a quick style pass. who can take the PR review? :shipit:
Sam: I can review the docs changes tonight. I'll leave inline comments for any phrasing that feels too marketing-y.
Noelle: starting a quick sweep. will push a small commit to normalize casing and add an inline example clarifying `model` usage.
Maya: example suggestion for the SDK migration block (feel free to copy):
```
# Before
response = client.generate(model_name="redwood-v1", prompt=prompt)

# After
response = client.generate(model="redwood-v1", prompt=prompt)
```
Ryan: nice. I'll add language-specific one-liners for Python/TS and a note for older clients that still accept `model_name` as alias.
Liam: glossary entry draft: 'model — the runtime parameter used to select an inference artifact; model version — specific immutable model build used for pinning/rollouts'. put it under docs/glossary/terms.md
Maya: tiny voice guidance: keep imperative, avoid marketing adjectives, prefer 'use' over 'leverage', and stick to lower-case product nouns unless referencing named products (e.g., Redwood Dedicated).
Noelle: +1. Also flagging two spots where we accidentally used American vs British spelling. I'll standardize to US English for docs.
Sam: CI ran on the branch — ci-bot shows build passed but one linkcheck warning for an internal design doc.
ci-bot: linkcheck: warning: /internal/design/kv-cache.md -> 404 (file moved).
Maya: thanks. Marking linkcheck warning in the PR. Liam, can you update the internal link or we can remove it from public docs?
Liam: I'll fix the link to point to the new runtime caching overview. quick commit incoming.
Noelle: PR checklist I'm adding in a comment: short summary, glossary updates, snippet migration note, SDK alias note, linkcheck green, two reviewers (docs + SDK).
Maya: perfect. Let's try to merge by EOD tomorrow if all changes land. tagging reviewers: @Sam @Ryan @Noelle :handshake:
Sam: sounds good. will finish review after 4pm PT.
Ryan: will prepare the TS/Go snippets and push before EOD.
Maya: thanks all — will post a merge comment that summarizes voice/terminology decisions for release notes. :tada:
